rationale: The post-change data establishes a stable defect rate of approximately 0.18%, which is statistically significantly below the 0.25% commitment. The report correctly computes and concludes target attainment based on this evidence. Moreover, the report demonstrates excellent practical and statistical restraint by identifying that the actual intervention was not documented. It explicitly prevents premature project closure and false causal claims by requiring the specific change to be recovered and approved before locking into standard work.
numerical_check: Recomputed post-change average proportion (147/80000 = 0.0018375), p-chart UCL (0.0038689), and verified the magnitude of the exact one-sided binomial test p-value (5.06e-5) using standard normal/Poisson approximations.
